_comment: Pinned digest of results/effect_sizes.csv (Chapter 1's headline figures and the per-cell effect sizes behind Sections 6.1 to 6.9): every data row and every column, keyed by (block, k, broker_count, ablation, metric), plus the row count. That key is unique over the whole file because the analysis emits exactly one row per combination of those five. Pinned whole rather than as a subset: 185 rows is small enough that a claim-bearing subset would save little. results/effect_sizes.csv is read-only input here and is never written by this script; only this pinned snapshot is written. Regenerate DELIBERATELY, never automatically, only after a verified intentional rerun of that analysis, by running from the repository root: python scripts/regenerate_golden_master.py
